title: SieveDaemonConfig: socket path and timeouts in smtp config
description:
Add the [sieve_daemon] config section to usenet-ipfs-smtp.

What: New SieveDaemonConfig struct in crates/smtp/src/config.rs; integrate into DeliveryConfig.

Algorithm:
1. Add to config.rs:
   pub struct SieveDaemonConfig {
     #[serde(default)] pub socket_path: String,          // default: empty (daemon disabled)
     #[serde(default="default_connect_timeout")] pub connect_timeout_ms: u64,  // default 200
     #[serde(default="default_request_timeout")] pub request_timeout_ms: u64,  // default 5000
   }
2. Add #[serde(default)] pub sieve_daemon: SieveDaemonConfig to DeliveryConfig.
3. Add fn sieve_daemon_enabled(&self) -> bool { !self.sieve_daemon.socket_path.is_empty() } helper.

Defensive rules: empty socket_path means daemon disabled (never try to connect); no panic on missing section (serde default handles it).
